title: Concept: XML parser with entities enabled (csharp) — review required
description: In csharp, DtdProcessing.Parse switches entity processing on. XXE payloads abuse doctypes to exfiltrate files and scan networks through the parser's authority. The remedy is disabling entities via DtdProcessing.Prohibit.
applicability: csharp XML parsing configuration; single-line lexical scope.
risk: File disclosure and SSRF through malicious XML; HIGH severity.
